title: 第599章 审第598章 沈知崖
lines: 与此同时，符台宫殿深处，功司偏殿
偏殿不大，正中摆着一张长案，案后端坐一名身着青灰官袍的老者，面容清癯，目光如鹰
他身侧立着两名录事，各捧一卷符简，笔尖悬着微光，随时准备记录
“驻符十二御卫，第五队”
老者的声音平淡，却夹杂着一股不怒自威
“此行受命随同玖台台主，前往青符天宗调查万符容天体，镇压天宗内乱一事，返程途中遭遇截杀，十二人折损过半，是否属实？”
仙卫长迈步上前，躬身行礼：
“属实”
“截杀方身份？”
“梦清乡，江小胖跟…李朔”
仙卫长的声音平静，但说到“李朔”二字时，眼角还是忍不住跳了一下
老者手中的笔顿了一下，他抬起头，鹰眼死死盯住仙卫长：
“李朔？”
“李朔居然出世了…有些麻烦，这家伙背景不小，不过…梦清乡从不会无缘无故刺杀”
老者的声音突然沉了下去
“你们可知是何人指使？”
仙卫长沉默了两息，才答道：
“属下不知”
老者看了他很久，最终没有追问，只是在符简上记了一笔：
“两名掌梦尊截杀，雇主不明”
“继续”他头也不抬，“如何脱困？”
仙卫长深吸一口气
这一问，才是关键，只见他深呼一口气缓缓开口道:
“一名前辈路过，出手惊退了梦清乡的人，那位前辈修为极高，没有留下姓名，事后自行离去”
老者挑眉：“前辈？何等模样？”
“灰袍，白发，面容苍老，不像是我们符域的人，可能是其他界域的”
仙卫长说这话时目光平静，身后的众仙卫同样面色如常，老者看了他良久，又低头在符简上记了几笔，笔尖在纸上划出沙沙的轻响
“那人出手时，你们可曾见他施展何种手段？”
仙卫长摇头：
“那位前辈出手太快，我等修为有限，只看到一道灰光掠过，李朔二人便倒飞出去，随即遁走，至于用的是什么手段，属下实在看不出来”
老者没有继续追问，转而翻过一页符简：
“万符容天体呢？”
仙卫长的心猛地提了一下，但他面上丝毫不显，沉声道：
“道体…道体被人截胡，我等赶到时，道体已不知所踪，青符天宗方面称，是今楼之人将其带走了”
功司偏殿的符灯突然跳了一下
那名鹰眼老者的动作顿住了，他的手停在半空，枯瘦的指尖离符简封只差半寸，就那么悬着，一动不动
殿内的空气忽然凝住了
“是吗？”
老者的声音不大，却像一根针扎进殿内每个人的耳膜，两名录事同时停笔，笔尖的符光僵在符简上方，不敢落下
仙卫长直视老者，面上依旧平静：
content_en:
At the same time, deep in the Futai Palace, the Gongsi Side Hall
The side hall is not big, with a long case in the middle. Behind the case sits an old man wearing a gray official robe, with a pale face and eyes like an eagle.
There are two recorders standing beside him, each holding a scroll of talismans, with a glimmer of light hanging from the tip of his pen, ready to record at any time.
"Twelve Guards Stationed in Talisman, Fifth Team"
The old man's voice was calm, but mixed with a sense of calm and self-restraint.
"On this trip, I was ordered to accompany the leader of Jiutai to Qingfu Tianzong to investigate the Wanfu Rong Celestial Body and suppress the civil strife in Tianzong. On the way back, I was intercepted and killed, and more than half of the twelve people were killed. Is it true?"
The Immortal Guard Chief stepped forward and bowed:
"True"
"The identity of the interceptor?"
"Meng Qingxiang, Xiaopang Jiang and...Li Shuo"
The voice of the Immortal Guard Chief was calm, but when he said the word "Li Shuo", the corners of his eyes still couldn't help but jump.
The pen in the old man's hand paused for a moment. He raised his head and stared at the Immortal Guard Chief with his eagle eyes:
"Li Shuo?"
"Yes"
"Li Shuo is actually born... It's a bit troublesome. This guy has a big background, but... Meng Qingxiang will never assassinate without any reason."
The old man's voice suddenly deepened
"Do you know who ordered this?"
The Immortal Guard Chief was silent for two breaths before replying:
"The subordinates don't know"
The old man looked at him for a long time and finally did not ask any further questions. He just made a note on the slip:
"Two Zhang Mengzun intercepted and killed, the employer is unknown"
"Continue" he said without raising his head, "How to get out of trouble?"
The Immortal Guard took a deep breath
This question was the key. He took a deep breath and slowly said:
"A senior passed by and scared away the men from Mengqingxiang. The senior was extremely advanced and did not leave his name. He left on his own afterward."
The old man raised his eyebrows: "Senior? What does he look like?"
"Gray robe, white hair, and old face. He doesn't look like someone from our Rune Realm. He may be from other realms."
The Immortal Guard Chief's eyes were calm when he said this, and the expressions of the Immortal Guards behind him were also as usual. The old man looked at him for a long time, then lowered his head and wrote a few strokes on the talisman slip, and the pen tip made a soft rustling sound on the paper.
"When that man took action, did you see what kind of methods he used?"
The Immortal Guard Chief shook his head:
"That senior took action too quickly, and our cultivation is limited. We only saw a gray light passing by, and Li Shuo and the two flew out, and then escaped. As for the method used, my subordinates really can't tell."
The old man did not continue to ask, but turned over a page of talisman slips:
"Where's Wanfu Rong Celestial Body?"
The Immortal Guard Chief's heart suddenly lifted, but he didn't show it at all on his face, and said in a deep voice:
"Dao Ti... Dao Ti was cut off by someone. When we arrived, Dao Ti was missing. Qingfu Tianzong said that someone from Jinlou took him away."
The talisman lamp in Gongsi's side hall suddenly jumped.
The movement of the eagle-eyed old man paused. His hand stopped in mid-air. His skinny fingertips were only half an inch away from the talisman seal. They were hanging there, motionless.
The air in the hall suddenly froze
"Really?"
The old man's voice was not loud, but it was like a needle piercing the eardrums of everyone in the hall. The two recorders stopped writing at the same time, and the talisman light on the pen tip froze above the talisman slip, daring not to drop it.
The Immortal Guard looked directly at the old man, his face still calm:
